research_rationale: The complete official original yields sixteen operative units after removing nonoperative headings, combining roster labels with their governing membership/invitation language, and splitting the page-crossing 1-203/1-204 merge. The Council is indefinite: yearly reporting, quarterly meetings and developing/maintaining coordination mechanisms are ongoing duties, not own-term sunsets or report-triggered termination. EO12379 section 9 supplies an immediate August 17, 1982 revocation without delayed effectiveness or saving. No genuine earlier amendment to those general Council duties is located; inactivity is not treated as legal termination. Accordingly the fifteen nondependent units have supported first ends on August 17, 1982, establishing the last Council end, while the express Pension Policy Commission director seat needs a separate earlier-ending analysis. Full dependency originals EO12071 and EO12100 show a sunset and a ratified effective date, but OFR points to a statutory extension by Public Law96-14 whose actual terms are not held. The director-seat first_end remains null rather than importing either a 1979 sunset preceding this original or the 1982 cleanup. This concrete clause-level uncertainty keeps the whole lifecycle incomplete despite the supported terminal revocation. Machine-chain actor/date contamination is rejected and provisional no retained. No image verification, exhaustion or human review is claimed.

savings_residuals.reason: The full original and revoker contain no express saving, transfer of Council duties, or independent future command beyond the Council. Coordination, research, common facilities/data, evaluation, annual reporting, quarterly meetings, support and subcommittees are Council functions. The order does not itself create ERISA benefit entitlements or repeal the independent responsibilities of member agencies. Commission-on-Pension-Policy staff authority arises under separate EO 12071/12100, not as a surviving EO 12262 command. Earlier ending of that director membership remains a first-end gap, not evidence of a continuing Council residual. This finding is bounded to the held complete original, revoker, and dependency orders.

unresolved_material_gaps: EARLIER_MEMBER_END: section 1-102(i) seats the Executive Director of the President's Commission on Pension Policy. EO 12071 section 1-402 expressly sunsets that Commission one year after effectiveness; EO 12100 section 1-101 ratifies September 21, 1978 effectiveness. Dependency EDGES identifies Public Law 96-14 (May 24, 1979) extending the Commission. The extension statute and final Commission/staff termination record are not held, so neither a pre-original lapse nor a later first end of this membership seat may be inferred. Its first_end remains null.
